note:
RJourney-run campground (formerly Pioneer Family Campground) minutes west of Raystown Lake (Huntingdon Co): 20/30/50-amp pull-through and back-in sites, many seasonal in the wooded ring, plus pool, mini golf, restaurant and cabins; near Seven Points and the Allegrippis bike trails. RV sites from $50/night (2026). Open April to October 15; office closed Mon-Tue. Good Sam 8.7; Google 4.3 over 119 reviews. --Claude
MINIMUM STAY: the operator's FAQ says 'Cabins and Transit sites have a 2-day minimum' (read 2026-10-20). --Claude
summary: Confirmed 50-amp electric and pull-throughs. Added water hookups, showers/dump/laundry/store (no Wi-Fi), season to October 15, online booking through RJourney's portal, a standing 2-night minimum for transit (nightly) sites, military 10% discount. Fees not confirmed: the park page now shows only a placeholder 'Starting at $4/night' and the booking portal refuses plain HTTP and shows no rates without dates (park closed for the season); the stored $50 from our note is left as is. Good Sam (from the directory) not mentioned by the operator; left.
